_doc: Night-time palette swap for the Xiao Guai HD-2D art. Every key of palette.js maps to another key of palette.js: darker and cooler, one step down its ramp (greens also lean teal, earth leans purple, water deepens). Apply it per pixel (map[key]) to any sprite to get the night version; in Godot use a palette-swap shader / a second texture built by tools/export_png.py (it writes <name>_night.png for the tiles listed in 'night_sprites'). The same table is used by preview.html.
